title: Anatomy of a data cascade
caption: A defect entered at collection passes every intermediate schema check, is converted into new derived state by each stage, and surfaces only at deployment — where the rework bill is every downstream artifact that consumed it. The widening band is remediation cost, not data volume.

title: The two contracts data keeps
caption: The dataset sits in both D·A·M overlaps at once. Left, the statistical contract with the algorithm: coverage, labels-as-spec, clean splits — the capability bound. Right, the physical contract with the machine: bytes arriving at the consumption rate — the throughput bound. Breaking either fails the system.

title: The ingestion boundary as a membrane
caption: Synchronous schema checks gate every record on the way in; failures go to the dead-letter queue rather than blocking or vanishing. Accepted data accumulates into windows the asynchronous statistical checks (PSI, K-S, parity replay) compare against the baseline — the two clocks are deliberately decoupled.
